home.description: Home directory for csync2 runtime data (e.g., lock files, temp files)

database_dir.description: Directory where csync2 stores its local database of file checksums and state

log_file.description: Path to the log file for csync2 operations

verbose.description: Verbosity level: 0 (quiet) to 3 (debug); higher values produce more detailed logs

exclude_patterns.description: List of file/directory patterns to exclude from synchronization (glob-style)

items.description: A glob or regex pattern to exclude files or directories

auth_mode.description: Authentication method: 'shared_secret' for PSK or 'ssl' for TLS mutual authentication

secret.description: Shared secret passphrase used for peer authentication (only used if auth_mode=shared_secret)

ssl_cert.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format) for mutual TLS authentication

ssl_key.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format) for mutual TLS authentication

ssl_ca.description: Path to the CA certificate file used to verify peer certificates (PEM format)

peers.description: List of hostnames/IPs in the sync cluster; each is referenced in the 'host' directive

items.description: A peer node in the csync2 cluster

name.description: Fully qualified hostname or IP address of the peer

groups.description: List of file groups to synchronize, each with a set of paths and optional attributes

items.description: A group of paths to sync as one unit

name.description: Name of the group (used for logging and debugging)

paths.description: Absolute paths to include in this group (files or directories)

auto.description: If true, csync2 will automatically trigger sync (e.g., via inotify). If false, must be triggered manually.

group.description: OS group ownership to apply to synced files

user.description: OS user ownership to apply to synced files

timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for a sync operation to complete
